description: This file provides utility functions to generate deterministic, stable identifiers from a secret salt using HMAC-SHA256. It includes functions to retrieve the secret salt from environment variables with a fallback, and to derive a short, URL-safe ID based on the salt and an optional context.

methods.name: getAuthSecretSalt
methods.description: Retrieves the secret salt from environment variables or falls back to a default constant.

methods.name: deriveDeterministicUserId
methods.description: Generates a deterministic, URL-safe ID string from the secret salt using HMAC-SHA256, with optional context and byte length parameters.
